Hello FAM Living team,

I would like to discuss extending my current tenancy contract for another year, as I am happy with the apartment and would like to continue living here.

At the same time, I had an urgent maintenance issue last night. The water heater started leaking heavily, and I would appreciate it if you could arrange for someone to inspect and repair or replace it as soon as possible.

Could you please contact the apartment owner to discuss the renewal terms and rental conditions for the next year? At the same time, I would be grateful if you could help me resolve the water heater issue urgently.

Please let me know when you have an update from the owner and when the maintenance team can come to fix the water heater.

Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to your response.
